messages:
maria g: Quick check — finishing RCA for INC-942. I exported the action list, there are 7 items that need cross-team owners + due dates. Can folks ack ownership or assign a delegate by EOD PST? :calendar:
jonathan h: ack. I'll take the infra action (investigate autoscaling misconfig). ETA Wed EOD (2025-11-12). Adding risk tag: 'capacity-regen'
tia r: tagging in platform here — I can pick up the rollout checklist item (canary gating / traffic split). Target Mon EOD. Will link the playbook in a sec. :+1:
alex k: I can own the monitoring alert tuning and add thresholds PR. Assigning to myself, will submit PR by tomorrow morning and request review from @jonathan h.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Note: related PR #4281 merged to staging at 2025-11-10T14:23Z
jonathan h: @alex k re: review, I can do it after the 11:00 stand. Expect comments by 12:30. Also flagging a dependent task: DB index rollout — needs coordination with data team. Who's the cross-team contact?
maria g: @sam (cc data eng) was listed in the postmortem notes but is currently OOO. If data eng can't pick up, we should schedule a short sync. For now, I'll mark as 'awaiting-data' and set tentative due Fri.
tia r: quick Q — is the canary scope limited to 10% traffic or do we want the 5% conservative plan? I prefer 5% initially to reduce blast radius.
jonathan h: agree on 5%. We'll keep rollback window at 30m. Put that in the rollout checklist.
alex k: PR reference: ``tools/alerts/thresholds.yaml`` changed with new SLO guardrails. Small snippet: ```- alert: HighInferenceLatency
  expr: p99_latency > 1200
  for: 5m```
maria g: thanks. Can each owner add a short one-line status update to the action item spreadsheet (sheet link pasted in PM) so I can close the RCA loop? I'll do a follow-up summary tomorrow AM and ping exec-summaries if all owners confirmed.
tonight-bump: [reminder-bot] Gentle reminder scheduled for 2025-11-11T18:00Z to sweep unassigned items.
jonathan h: added DB index contact as @karim d and set dependency note. If data eng can't commit, I'll prepare a fallback query plan.
tia r: added canary config to the playbook and set canary scope = 5%, rollback = automatic on error rate > 0.5%. Done.
alex k: PR opened with alert changes, assigned reviewers @jonathan h and @tia r.
maria g: great — marking items: infra -> @jonathan h (due 2025-11-12), rollout -> @tia r (due 2025-11-10), monitoring -> @alex k (due 2025-11-11), data idx -> @karim d (tentative 2025-11-14 awaiting confirm). If anyone needs date shifts, reply here. Otherwise I'll close on Mon afternoon. :white_check_mark:
